summary: Idler wheel for 2400 series tracks: a flat black disc with a raised outer rim, a recessed web with lightening slots and a ring of bolt-boss holes, and a central bore that takes a flanged ball bearing. The kit holds two wheels plus four flanged bearings, two socket-head screws, four washers and two nyloc nuts. The part analyzed here is a single idler wheel.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat inner hub face. The flanged bearing seats in the central bore here and the wheel spins on the screw and bearing axis.
Opposite hub face with the same central bore. A second flanged bearing seats here, so the bearings sit on both sides of the wheel.

notes: No dimensions are given in the scraped data, so every size is an estimate. Assumptions: (1) The wheel runs on the 2400 series track, which uses a 12-tooth sprocket of roughly 72 mm diameter. The idler is drawn slightly smaller than the sprocket beside it in the product insight image, so about 72 mm is a plausible diameter. (2) Thickness of about 16 mm comes from the rim depth relative to the diameter in the photos. (3) The central bore is assumed to be about 8 mm, matching the flanged bearing OD of a standard goBILDA 8 mm bore bearing and the M4 screw hardware in the kit. The bearing bore is about 4 mm, so the screw is likely M4. (4) The small hole ring is assumed to be 8 holes of 4 mm diameter on a 56 mm bolt circle, following the 8 mm grid. These holes are only loosely visible in the photos, so the count and positions are uncertain. (5) The lightening slots, hex pockets and ribs are not modeled. The stated weight is 29 g per wheel.
